description.text:
【About the Role】
We are seeking a Quantum Computing Applications Research Scientist to pioneer the integration of quantum computing into next-generation enterprise scientific computing platforms, accelerating breakthroughs in materials discovery and precision health.
This role focuses on exploring how quantum computing can be integrated with existing high-performance computing (HPC) infrastructure to enable hybrid classical–quantum scientific workflows. You will investigate practical pathways toward quantum advantage, evaluate emerging quantum hardware technologies, and develop application-oriented quantum algorithms for real-world scientific challenges.
The ideal candidate possesses a strong background in quantum computing, computational science, and scientific research, with the ability to bridge theoretical quantum mechanics, enterprise applications, and future hybrid computing architectures.
【Key Responsibilities】
1. Quantum Algorithm & Application Development
• Design, implement, and optimize quantum and hybrid classical–quantum algorithms for scientific applications.
• Develop quantum workflows targeting materials discovery, molecular simulations, electronic structure calculations, and precision health.
• Evaluate quantum algorithms for practical enterprise-scale scientific computing problems.
2. Hybrid Quantum-HPC Computing
• Develop hybrid computing workflows integrating quantum processors with classical HPC infrastructure.
• Evaluate computational performance and identify opportunities for quantum acceleration.
• Explore scalable hybrid computing architectures combining CPUs, GPUs, and quantum processors (QPUs).
3. Quantum Hardware Evaluation & Technology Roadmapping
• Track and analyze advances in quantum hardware, including gate-model systems and quantum annealers.
• Benchmark emerging quantum platforms and evaluate their applicability to enterprise scientific computing.
• Forecast the impact of quantum hardware scaling, error correction, and fault-tolerant quantum computing on future enterprise computing infrastructure.
4. Cross-Disciplinary Scientific Translation
• Translate quantum mechanics and mathematical formulations into computational frameworks accessible to materials scientists, computational chemists, bioinformaticians, and software engineers.
• Collaborate with multidisciplinary research teams to identify practical opportunities for quantum computing applications.
5. Research Collaboration & Innovation
• Collaborate with academic institutions, industry partners, and internal research teams.
• Publish technical reports, white papers, and research publications.
• Contribute to the long-term quantum computing technology roadmap and internal capability development.

key_values.label: 其他條件
key_values.text:
【Required Qualifications】
1. Scientific Foundations
• Master's or Ph.D. in Materials Science, Physics, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Computational Chemistry, Computer Science, or other related disciplines.
• Strong theoretical foundation in quantum mechanics, solid-state physics, molecular simulation, or computational materials science.
• Experience performing scientific computing in Linux environments.
2. Quantum Computing
• Hands-on experience with quantum computing frameworks such as Qiskit, PennyLane, Ocean SDK, or equivalent quantum software platforms.
• Experience developing quantum algorithms using gate-based quantum computers and/or quantum annealers.
• Understanding of NISQ computing, quantum error mitigation, quantum error correction, and pathways toward quantum advantage.
3. Hybrid Scientific Computing
• Experience developing hybrid classical–quantum algorithms such as VQE, QAOA, or related quantum optimization methods.
• Understanding of hybrid CPU/GPU/QPU computing architectures and associated integration challenges.
• Experience with Python scientific computing and software development.
4. Research & Software Development
• Strong programming, software engineering, debugging, and scientific research skills.
• Ability to communicate complex scientific concepts across multidisciplinary teams.
【Other Qualifications (Good to Have)】
1. Materials Science & Computational Chemistry
• Research experience in computational materials science, first-principles simulations, molecular dynamics, or electronic structure calculations.
• Familiarity with Quantum ESPRESSO, VASP, CP2K, or similar computational chemistry software.
• Understanding of magnetic materials, electronic materials, semiconductor materials, or biomolecular simulations.
2. High Performance Computing
• Experience using HPC clusters, Slurm, PBS, distributed computing environments, or cloud-based scientific computing platforms.
• Experience optimizing large-scale scientific workloads on CPU and GPU architectures.
3. Quantum Hardware & Technology Strategy
• Familiarity with superconducting qubits, trapped ions, neutral atoms, photonic quantum computing, or quantum annealing technologies.
• Ability to evaluate quantum hardware roadmaps, benchmark emerging technologies, and assess future enterprise deployment strategies.
4. AI-Driven Scientific Computing
• Experience applying AI, machine learning, or LLM-based scientific assistants to scientific computing workflows.
• Experience integrating AI-assisted optimization into quantum or scientific computing pipelines.
5. Publications & Research Impact
• Publications in quantum computing, computational materials science, computational chemistry, condensed matter physics, or related research fields are highly preferred.
• Experience collaborating with academia, industry partners, or interdisciplinary research teams is a strong plus.
